name: glitchtip
description: Query GlitchTip organizations, projects, issues, events, tags, releases, environments, monitors, logs, and issue metadata through Hivy's pre-authenticated GlitchTip REST proxy using HIVY_GLITCHTIP_URL, HIVY_GLITCHTIP_TOKEN, curl, and jq; construct dashboard links with HIVY_GLITCHTIP_DASHBOARD_BASE_URL, never the Hivy proxy URL.
